body: It's `int64_t` instead of `size_t` because `from` and `to` are changed to the return value of `PackedStringArray::find()` and `PackedStringArray::rfind()` respectively, both of which return `int64_t` instead of `size_t`.

It's specifically to clear up why it's
```cpp
int64_t idx = marker_names.rfind(p_call->arguments[1]->reduced_value);
```
and not
```cpp
int64_t idx = marker_names.rfind(p_call->arguments[2]->reduced_value);
```

(One would expect the end marker's value to be in index 2 at a glance, but it's actually in index 1)

`CODE_COMPLETION_KIND_FUNCTION` is used so it is consistent with the animation name argument.

The animation name argument's completion is taken from `get_argument_options()` and uses `CODE_COMPLETION_KIND_FUNCTION` too. See here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/cb7cd815eeeb11aaa1f68453a515c76bec5ba73d/modules/gdscript/gdscript_editor.cpp#L3004-L3031

Ok so, this is considered a bug. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/87509 and https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/101092

None of the categories seem to match semantically, so let's just use `CODE_COMPLETION_KIND_PLAIN_TEXT`.
I must add, this is also part of why a rework is due, [as mentioned above](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111546#issuecomment-3394367364).
